spans.s:
शोत्स्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, about to cleanse or
purify.
सोतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be poured out, &c.

1. सोतृ, ता, त्री, तृ (for 2. see p. 1118, col. 2),
Ved. one who presses out the Soma plant, one who
pours out libations.

2. सोतृ, ता, त्री, तृ (for 1. see p. 1117, col. 3),
engendering, generating, bringing forth children.

सोत्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = सोतव्य, to be poured
out or offered, (Sāy. अभिषोतव्य, Ṛg-veda

सोत्कण्ठ सोत्कण्ठ (स-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ar-
dently longing, impatiently eager; regretful; bewail-
ing, sorrowing; (अम्), ind. with ardent or eager
longing; regretfully, sorrowfully.

सोत्कम्प सोत्कम्प (स-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, trem-
bling, tremulous.

सोत्पल सोत्पल (स-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, pos-
sessing lotuses.

सोत्पीड सोत्पीड (स-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, covered
with foam or froth.

सोत्प्रास सोत्प्रास (स-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
excess, excessive; exaggerated, exaggerating ironic-
[]
ally; (अस्), m. violent laughter; (अस्, अम्), m. n.
ironical exaggeration, sarcasm, flattering speech, sneer-
ing praise and covert censure.
—सोत्प्रास-हसित,
अम्, n. sarcastic laughter.

सोत्सव सोत्सव (स-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, festive,
making merry, joyous.

सोत्साह सोत्साह (स-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, making
effort, vigorous, energetic, persevering; (अम्), ind.
energetically, carefully.
—सोत्साह-ता, f. activity,
energy.

सोत्सुक सोत्सुक (स-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, regret-
ful, repining, anxious, sorrowful, languid.
